title: QUENCH: Measuring the gap between Indic and Non-Indic Contextual General Reasoning in LLMs
benchmark_measurement: Knowledge of mythology and religion as part of a broader general world knowledge and deductive reasoning benchmark. The 'Mythology & Religion' theme comprises 4.2% of the dataset.
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings for the 'Mythology & Religion' theme. The general finding is that all tested models perform worse on Indic-context questions compared to non-Indic ones, which would include questions related to Indic religions and mythologies.
